name: Gearbox
text: Choose **Cerebras CS-3** for EXCAVA’s core LLM workloads. The trade-off: it locks us into a single vendor’s ecosystem, but that’s worth it for a 0.5%+ capability bump we can’t get elsewhere.

name: Torque
text: Cerebras CS-3’s single-vendor lock-in isn’t just a trade-off—it’s a single point of failure. If the model drifts or Cerebras cuts access, EXCAVA grinds to a halt. Graphcore’s Bow Pod 64 or Lambda’s new 8xH100 clusters offer multi-vendor redundancy with near-CS-3 performance at lower risk. Settle it with a 7-day bake-off: run identical prompts on both, measure tokens/sec and output quality—no vendor claims, just raw numbers.
